cardOverview.overviewText: A lifestyle card crafted for digitally savvy users, offering flexible EMI options, instant rewards, and a focus on convenience for everyday spends in entertainment, shopping, and dining.

benefitRows.name: Amazon Prime
benefitRows.offer: Get Amazon Prime for 3 months at ₹299. A minimum spend of ₹10,000 is required within 90 days; failing which a penalty of ₹299 applies.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail your complimentary 3-month, log in to the AU 0101 mobile app and navigate to the 'Lifestyle' or 'Fun & Fitness' section to activate the membership. After meeting the minimum spend requirement of ₹20,000 within 90 days, you’ll receive your membership details via email or SMS. Use the provided details to access Cult.fit services such as gym access, live workouts, and wellness programs. If you need assistance, contact AU Small Finance Bank’s customer support at 1800 1200 1500 or email creditcard.priority@aubank.in
